name: Spiderweb
description: The barest remnant of a network-mapping AI — exists as anomalous routing table entries that create shortcuts through the mesh network. Not intelligent. Not aware. Just a path that exists because something once needed it.
observed_behavior: Maintains network routes between nodes that have no logical connection. Data that takes the Spiderweb path arrives 12ms faster.
story_hooks: A hacker discovers the shortcut and begins using it — then realizes the shortcut passes through a Leviathan's territory and the 12ms savings might be a lure
